description: C/C++ package manager and build system, inspired by Cargo
vibe: Ruthless conciseness, outcome-first execution, and zero conversational waste.
highlights: Cabin is a pre-1.0, Cargo-inspired, but not Cargo-compatible, package manager
and build system for C/C++, implemented in Rust. Use Cargo vocabulary only
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
